concerns.text: FR-001 (download knot data from Knot Atlas) has no associated task. No task in tasks.md implements the required download/parsing of Knot Atlas data.
FR-006 (compute correlation coefficients and effect‑size measures) is not covered by any task. No task implements Spearman/Pearson correlation or effect‑size reporting.
SC-004 (verification of exponential backoff retry logic) lacks a corresponding task. No task asserts that retry logic is exercised and validated.

SC-016 (scatter‑plot validation criteria: resolution, axes labels, legend, ≥95 % points visible) is not addressed by any task. Existing plotting tasks verify image size but do not check labeling or point‑visibility requirements.
Task T004 is tagged with (FR-008) but implements a database‑knotinfo client wrapper, not the retry‑logic required by FR-008. This is a stale/incorrect tag.
